cards.name: Kirara(Main Character)
cards.desc:
Up to now, I was supporting everyone from behind most of the time,
but from now on, I'd like to lead everyone from the front, well, kinda……
Alright! Lamp, let's give it our best!

cards.name: Lamp(Main Character)
cards.desc:
A Goddess Apprentice must also have excellent skills with the sword……
Well, at least someday in the future! …… Otherwise, I would have to stay behind Kirara-san or all the Creamates and hide myself there forever.
So I have to work really hard!

cards.name: Clea(Main Character)
cards.desc:
Is it alright for me to come with you?
Up to now, I always stayed in the Town to wait for everyone's return, but……
I want to be much more helpful to everyone!
So I'll give my very best!

cards.name: Archive(Main Character)
cards.desc:
I'm Archive, the Head Priest.
Since you asked for me, I came to help.
…… By the way, do you know where Sola-sama is?
I see, so she sneaked out of the Monastery once again……
Well, forget about that. For now, you may count on me.

cards.name: Media(Main Character)
cards.desc:
My name is Media.
Normally, I spend my time with creating copies of the Scriptures at the Scribes’ Guild, but……
Now, I've been asked to work as a mage.
I'll give my best so I can be of your help!

cards.name: Sumeragi Utsutsu(Main Character)
cards.desc:
H-Hey.
I only have some trashy skills, so why are did you get someone like me……?
I bet that you weren’t even aiming for me……
Ugh…… Sorry that it was me that got summoned.

cards.name: Highpris(Main Character)
cards.desc:
I'm Highpris.
For all those people of this world who seek help, I shall vow that I work to help these people.
I truly believe that this is my chance to return the favor to Etoilia, and to Sola-sama who forgave me for all of my sins.
